llm_response.reason: The website https://www.keensoutletcolombia.com/ appears to be a scam due to several red flags. Firstly, the prices listed on the website ($528,232, $353,049, etc.) seem unusually high and may be an attempt to lure customers into making a purchase. Additionally, the website's domain name 'keensoutletcolombia.com' may be an attempt to mimic the legitimate Keen footwear brand. The lack of transparency in the website's 'Declaración de privacidad' (privacy statement) and the absence of a clear 'Opciones de pago' (payment options) section also raise concerns. Furthermore, the website's 'Contactar con Nosotros' (contact us) section does not provide a physical address or a legitimate contact email, which is a common trait among scam websites. Overall, these factors suggest that the website is likely a fake online shopping scam.
